about: Provisional match-level annotations from visual inspection of the original footage, cross-referenced with M1's earlier visible-text windows. These are NOT human-approved truth and NOT a transcription of M2 predictions. Times are clip video seconds. Windows include sampling/confirmation delay; opened/closed windows describe the visible ownership boundaries, so delayed recognition of an editorial cut is an error. Clip1 and clip2 replay the same real match; do not sum them as unique matches.

clip1.notes: The start of the real match is absent. Opening at the recording boundary means first observation, not a known match start.
